families.title: Slant height and surface area of a cone

families.title: Volume of a cone

families.title: Area and perimeter of composite shapes with semicircles, quadrants, triangles and trapeziums

families.title: Surface area and volume of a cube combined with a hemisphere or cylinder
families.method: cube combined with hemisphere / cylinder: exposed surface = cube faces - covered circle + added surface; volumes added or subtracted

families.title: Volume and surface area of a frustum of a cone
families.method: frustum: V = pi h (R^2 + R r + r^2)/3; l = sqrt(h^2 + (R - r)^2); CSA = pi (R + r) l; TSA adds both ends

families.title: Area of a triangle by Heron's formula

families.title: Area of a quadrilateral split along a diagonal
families.method: split along the diagonal and add the two Heron triangle areas (exact)

families.title: Modelling real objects (tents, bowls, tanks, cones) as combinations of solids

families.title: Surface area of pyramids with rectangular, triangular, hexagonal and other bases
families.method: faces by hand: rectangular base two pairs of triangles; regular n-gon base n triangles + base area n a^2 cot(pi/n)/4 (sympy exact cot)

families.title: Surface area of a square pyramid
families.method: square pyramid: l = sqrt(h^2 + (a/2)^2) when height given; lateral = 4 x (1/2) a l; total adds a^2

families.title: Volume of a pyramid
families.method: volume = 1/3 base area x height; bases: square, rectangle, right triangle

families.title: Melting and recasting solids

families.title: Finding the angle or radius of a sector
families.method: invert the sector formulas: theta = 360 arc/(2 pi r) or 360 A/(pi r^2); r = sqrt(360 A/(pi theta))

families.title: Area of a segment of a circle
families.method: segment = sector - triangle (1/2 r^2 sin theta using the stated sqrt3 / sin 90 = 1); major = circle - minor

families.title: Hollow spheres and hemispherical bowls
families.method: metal in a hollow ball 4/3 (R^3 - r^3) (x pi), bowl 2/3 (R^3 - r^3); bowl surface = 2 pi r^2 + 2 pi R^2 + pi (R^2 - r^2)

families.title: Surface area and volume of a sphere or hemisphere
families.method: sphere 4 pi r^2, 4/3 pi r^3; hemisphere 3 pi r^2 total and 2/3 pi r^3 (diameter halved)

families.title: Matching a set of real numbers with its interval notation

families.title: Intersection, union and difference of intervals

families.title: The identity element and inverses for a binary operation

families.title: Binary operations modulo n, by a table and on matrices

families.title: Is a binary operation commutative, associative, both or neither?

families.title: The fewest pairs that make a relation an equivalence relation

families.title: Testing a relation for reflexivity, symmetry and transitivity
